models.note_en: The official dedicated repository lists released UMI and RoboTwin checkpoints and a 2026-06-15 release. The report describes the VLA manipulation policy and full learning stack. VLM and RxBrain branches are separate cognition models, not later replacements for this action policy.
models.note_cn: 官方独立仓库列出 UMI 与 RoboTwin 权重及 2026-06-15 发布记录。报告讨论 VLA 操作策略及完整学习流程；VLM 与 RxBrain 是独立认知模型，不视为该动作策略的新版本。

models.note_en: Official HY-Embodied repository records 2026-07-15 release with weights. This is the current embodied VLM branch; preserve it alongside the distinct RxBrain cognition branch without ranking their incompatible evaluations or inventing a release order from papers.
models.note_cn: 官方 HY-Embodied 仓库记录 2026-07-15 发布并提供权重。这是当前具身 VLM 分支，与独立 RxBrain 认知分支并列保留，不比较不兼容的评测，也不从论文日期推断二者发布先后。

models.note_en: Official repository states report, inference code and model weights released in July 2026. The cognition model combines language-visual reasoning and imagination; month-only release evidence does not establish a latest-order tie-break against VLM-1.0. Paper first submission is recorded independently.
models.note_cn: 官方仓库说明报告、推理代码与模型权重于 2026 年 7 月发布。该认知模型结合语言视觉推理和想象；月份精度的发布证据不足以判定它与 VLM-1.0 的 latest 顺序，论文首次提交另行记录。
models.release_evidence: 【第四轮联网复核·官方仓库已有佐证日】腾讯该型号官方README确认2026年7月发布报告、模型权重及推理代码；官方仓库7月18日已经有用户Issue，取其具体可核验日作为最迟已公开日，未将其冒充发布日。

models.note_en: NVIDIA GEAR-affiliated mixed-collaboration robot world model; official repository links public code/checkpoints/data and records their 2026-02-18 release. It predicts action-conditioned world dynamics and supports policy evaluation, not a VLA action-policy release. Preserve this current specialized family alongside Cosmos; paper dates and model artifact availability are distinct.
models.note_cn: NVIDIA GEAR 参与、多机构合作的机器人世界模型；官方仓库提供代码、权重与数据并记录其 2026-02-18 发布。模型预测动作条件下的世界动态并支持策略评测，不属于 VLA 动作策略。与 Cosmos 并列保留该当前专业分支，论文日期与模型资源公开时间分开记录。
